patterns.what_worked: The three-valued verdict made the class-side fix a two-line shape: latch the id on 'resolved', latch false only on 'absent', latch nothing on 'unresolved'. Pinning it with a client profile that answers NO id (the name-only TBC fixture with the C_Spell id -> name bridge) proved the direction rather than asserting it: a resolved rank on that client can only come from the name path. The mutation battery caught its own false kills (two mutants were Lua 5.1 syntax errors - 'return' must end a block - so the battery now parse-checks every mutant with luac5.1 -p before running the suite).
patterns.what_was_hard: Deciding the retry bound: the latch is also read from the per-frame gather_guide_inputs path, so an unbounded retry would re-walk the rank table every frame on a client that cannot answer. Mirroring the rogue lane's 5s per-table backoff fixed it without touching the resolved path.
patterns.skill_gap: The bench artifact's first draft asserted the harness step-count delta without checking tests/run.sh's mtime; the sibling lane's edit was the cause and it was only verifiable after the fact. Verify the cause of a count change before writing it down.
